title: How to earn passive income with AI in 2026: 5 proven methods

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: By 2026, AI protocols like AutoML will automate income streams—no coding needed. This is how it’s done.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But "how" misses the point. Real passive income comes from owning AI tech, not just using it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AutoML and no-code tools already let non-experts deploy AI models. It’s scalable, fast, and accessible.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Ownership matters. If you don’t control the AI, you’re just a user. Real value is in training and licensing models.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You can license models via protocols like ONNX—true ownership and passive income in one.
